title: Joint Probabilistic Data Association Multi Object Tracker
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multi-Object Tracking Algorithms/Joint_Probabilistic_Data_Association_Multi_Object_Tracker.md
text: Joint probabilistic data association tracker, 5 inputs, 4 outputs, {Out-of-sequence measurements handling} sets Out-of-sequence measurements handling; {Tracker identifier} sets the unique tracker identifier, {Filter initialization function}, {Value of k for k-best JPDA}, {Feasible joint events generation function name}, {Maximum number of tracks}, {Maximum number of sensors}, {Absolute tolerance between time stamps of detections}, {Maximum number of OOSM steps}, {Track state parameters} sets the parameters of track state reference frame, {Update track state parameters with time}, {Enable memory management}, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Threshold for assigning detections to tracks}, {Threshold to initialize a track}, {Probability of detection}, {Spatial density of clutter measurements}, {Type of track confirmation and deletion logic} sets the confirmation and deletion logic type, {Confirmation threshold [M N]} sets the track confirmation threshold for history logic, {Deletion threshold [P Q]} sets the track deletion threshold for history logic, {Threshold for registering ’hit’ or ’miss’} sets the threshold for registering, {Confirmation threshold [Probability]} sets the track confirmation threshold for integrated, {Deletion threshold [Probability]} sets the track deletion threshold for integrated, {Spatial density of new targets}, {Time rate of true target deaths}, {Prediction time source} sets the source of prediction time, {Enable cost matrix input} enables input port for cost matrix, {Enable detectable track IDs input}, {Enable tentative tracks output} enables output port for tentative tracks, {Enable all tracks output} enables output port for all tracks, {Enable information output} enables output port for analysis, {Source of output bus name} sets the source of output track bus name, {Source of output info bus name}, {Maximum number of detections per sensor}, {Maximum number of detections per cluster}, {Maximum number of tracks per cluster} and {Handle run-time violation of cluster size}. Values come from the instance.
